title: How to Not Die Alone
author: Logan Ury
description: A behavioral scientist and dating coach explains why smart people struggle in love and how to fix it. Drawing on psychology and research, Ury shows how to stop sabotaging your own relationships and find a partner who is right for you.

title: Early Indians
author: Tony Joseph
description: Using the latest findings in genetics, archaeology, and linguistics, Tony Joseph traces the story of how we came to be: the successive waves of migration that shaped the Indian people, and what they say about our shared ancestry.

title: The Gene: An Intimate History
author: Siddhartha Mukherjee
description: From Mendel's pea plants to CRISPR, a Pulitzer-winning physician tells the story of the gene and its power over our health, identity, and future, woven through the history of his own family's struggles with hereditary illness.

title: Frames of Mind
author: Howard Gardner
description: The book that introduced the theory of multiple intelligences. Gardner argues that intelligence is not a single measurable thing, and that linguistic, musical, spatial, interpersonal, and other abilities each deserve recognition.

title: வாசிப்பது எப்படி?
author: செல்வேந்திரன்
description: வாசிப்பைத் தொடங்குவது எப்படி, எதைப் படிப்பது, தொடர்ந்து வாசிக்கும் பழக்கத்தை எப்படி வளர்த்துக்கொள்வது என்பதை எளிய நடையில் விளக்கும் நூல். புதிய வாசகர்களுக்கும் தீவிர வாசகர்களுக்கும் பயனுள்ள வழிகாட்டி.
